note: Weights are AI-inferred from Zach's ask and his standing UI rules (calm UI, one answer first, detail on demand; resizable remembered panels; degrees; plain words). He may move them.

requirements.name: One answer first, detail on demand
requirements.why: Zach's standing rule for every dashboard: one calm answer first, detail one step away. Today each tab opens on a wall of charts and the page header is a paragraph.
requirements.passCondition: On load and on every tab, the first thing read is a one-line answer (what, how big, when) with its single best chart; the rest is one click away.

anchors.1: Every tab opens on its full chart wall; the answer must be read off the plots.
anchors.3: A summary exists on some tabs or at the top, but the detail still competes with it.
anchors.5: Every tab leads with a computed one-line answer and one chart; detail is folded and one click away.

requirements.name: Finding the channel that matters among 27
requirements.why: The Diagnostics tab is a wall of 27 equal-weight chips; the controller's flags (collision, blocked, at cap) and the continuous signals are mixed, and nothing says which ones moved.
requirements.passCondition: From the Diagnostics tab, the channels that changed during the run are visible first, grouped in plain words, and any of the 27 is reachable in two actions or a few typed letters.

anchors.1: A flat wall of equal chips; the user must try them one by one.
anchors.3: Grouped or searchable, but which channels moved is not shown.
anchors.5: Changed channels first with their moment; grouping or search reaches any channel in ≤ 2 actions; flat channels folded.

requirements.name: One time across 3D and every chart
requirements.why: The time lane is today's one time control; Zach's playback rule is that dragging time on any figure syncs all the others, and the worst moment is one click.
requirements.passCondition: Play, step, scrub on any chart and Worst moment move the 3D, every chart and the lane together; the time control is visible from every tab without scrolling.

anchors.1: Time controls are per-chart or scroll away; 3D and charts can disagree.
anchors.3: Synced, but the control scrolls away or Worst moment is buried.
anchors.5: Synced everywhere, always in view, Worst moment one click, the playhead readable at a glance.

requirements.name: A calm 3D panel
requirements.why: Today the 3D shares its column with a legend, four run rows and five sliders, so the view itself is a third of the column.
requirements.passCondition: The 3D view fills its panel at rest; trail, look-ahead, error magnification, marker settings and per-run draw options are folded but one step away.

anchors.1: Sliders and legends take more space than the view.
anchors.3: Settings fold, but the panel still carries chrome the view does not need at rest.
anchors.5: The view fills the panel; every setting is one step away and its state is still legible.

requirements.name: Runs toggled and compared from one place
requirements.why: Runs are toggled in three places today (3D rows, legend chips, lane tracks); comparing a run's value at the playhead needs the lane.
requirements.passCondition: One place toggles and solos a run for 3D and every chart, shows its colour and its value at the playhead.

anchors.1: Toggles scattered, out of sync, or per chart.
anchors.3: One place, but no solo or no value at the playhead.
anchors.5: One place: eye, solo, colour key and the value at the playhead, reflected everywhere at once.

requirements.name: Fits traj_compare
requirements.why: The winner must land in src/traj_compare (vanilla JS, uPlot, three.js, the payload's tabs/sections/channels) without a rewrite.
requirements.passCondition: The layout is built from the payload as it is and the existing chart / 3D / lane parts, with a bounded change.

anchors.1: Needs a new data model or a different chart/3D engine.
anchors.3: Same stack and payload, but most of the page shell is rewritten.
anchors.5: Same payload and parts; the change is mostly layout and a few new derived numbers.

hardGates.name: 3D left, question tabs right
hardGates.why: Zach's stated structure: the redesign happens inside it.

hardGates.name: Content kept
hardGates.why: "I think the content is good": all six tabs, all 27 channels, eye toggles, deg/rad, Worst moment, transport and Open in Rerun must stay reachable.

hardGates.name: Resizable, remembered, foldable
hardGates.why: Standing rule: every panel boundary draggable, its size remembered, the inspector foldable.

hardGates.name: Same real fixture, offline, no console errors
hardGates.why: Fair comparison and traj_compare's file:// contract: the one X1.ElbowStop@-60 payload, vendored libraries, 0 console errors.
